RESIDUAL 1 (items hydration error), not reproduced on the integrated stack: no pageerror or console error on /en/items, /fr/items or filtered/paged/size=all URLs at 1280x720/1280x800/1440/390. The flows of items.spec (card click lands on /en/items/1001-boots), navigation.spec (search + chip + copy URL reopens with 3 cards and 2 active chips) and catalogue/filters.spec (search+reload, chip+clear, next page, size=all keeps lang=en_GB, '/' shortcut, sheet) all behave (flows.mjs). Root cause of the error the reviewers saw (HOME review, pre-integration): catalogue-list.html rendered the grid as <ul>/<li> (git show db5ec031^1, l.54-63). Riot's bare <li> inside lodb-rich-text (RICH_TEXT_TAGS allows 'li') in the item Description accordion (Emberknife 1035 is on page 1) made the HTML parser close the grid <li> early and reparent the rest of the card, so hydration's node lookup returned null ('Cannot set properties of null (setting __ngContext__)') and the click stayed on /en/items. It was fixed by LISTS commit 241171be (div role=list/listitem, catalogue-list.html:62-78), integrated in db5ec031. Keep the SSR spec. Any future list markup must not put lodb-rich-text inside li or p.

RESIDUAL 5 (page weight), measured; not a regression against the legacy. HTML raw/gzip: /en/champions 255 KB/61 KB against the legacy /champions 658 KB/90 KB; /en/items 462 KB/85 KB against the legacy /objects 4.64 MB/391 KB. The legacy renders every card, the new stack renders 12 plus transfer state. Total transfer, cold load with browser cache on: champions 1013 KB (1440) and 1074 KB (390) against 2583/1264 KB; items 646/634 against 724/654; runes 509 against 801/433; summoners 432 against 346/306; home 609 against 482. The extra on home, runes and summoners is the Angular JS (~200 KB against ~80 KB), not portraits or descriptions. Composition of the new /en/items SSR: main 231 KB (12 cards x ~17.5 KB, driven by the evolution chips, each a full lodb-catalogue-image picture/source/img, and 16 empty comment anchors per lodb-icon), ng-state 120 KB (the page-1 list 42 KB, plus i18n/en 25 KB, i18n/about 9.6 KB, i18n/api 6 KB and changelog manifest 8.6 KB on every page, which are shell scopes: group A), inline critical CSS 76 KB; after hydration the full list JSON adds 188 KB. On the new stack each hotlinked portrait/icon is requested twice (parser, then again after hydration); the second is a memory-cache hit (0 bytes), so it is harmless.
